# cursor_origin_ssh_certificate_authorities (Data Source)

Lists the SSH certificate authorities an Origin owner trusts, newest first, and whether the owner requires certificates. Uses the provider auth token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_origin_ssh_certificate_authorities" "acme" {
  owner = "acme"
}

output "acme_ssh_ca_fingerprints" {
  value = data.cursor_origin_ssh_certificate_authorities.acme.certificate_authorities[*].fingerprint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `owner` (String) Owner slug of the team namespace.

### Read-Only

- `certificate_authorities` (Attributes List) Every authority the owner trusts, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificate_authorities))
- `require_certificates` (Boolean) Whether the owner requires SSH certificates for git over SSH.

<a id="nestedatt--certificate_authorities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `certificate_authorities`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 time the authority was added.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the public key as SHA256:<base64>.
- `id` (String) Origin-assigned authority ID (nsca_...).
- `key_type` (String) OpenSSH key type of the public key, for example ssh-ed25519.
- `name` (String) Label given when the authority was added.
- `public_key` (String) The authority's public key as <key_type> <base64>, without a comment.
